vessel.description: Name of the vessel (e.g. MV ATLANTIC PIONEER)

cargo.description: Cargo type description (e.g. Milling Wheat in Bulk)

loadingPort.description: Loading port name and country (e.g. Piraeus, Greece)

loadingAgentEmail.description: Agent contact email at loading port

disch2AgentEmail.description: Agent contact email at 2nd discharge port
